The '''Frontier Vacation Package''' was a package holiday advertised and sold by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency<ref name="Star Tours" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4.3 ABY]]<ref name="KOTHB">{{Blog|holocron|7|Death Star timeline}}</ref> to a family resort on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bar Neth]]. Activities included visiting the [[Carl Hodgesville Dude Ranch]], playing on [[golf]] on zero-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] courses, camping, and safaris.<ref name="Star Tours" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Frontier Vacation Package was first mentioned in [[Tokyo Disneyland]]'s [[Wikipedia:Simulator ride|simulator ride]] [[Wikipedia:Amusement park|theme park]] attraction [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']], which opened on [[July 12]], [[1989]].<ref name="Star Tours" />
